name: Nem nướng
summary: Grilled pork paste from Ninh Hòa, rolled in dew-dried rice paper with herbs, pickles, fried ram, and a yellow-orange sauce. A bite is sweet, fatty, sour, tart, and crisp.
origin: Ninh Hòa, in Khánh Hòa. Eat it in Nha Trang.
history: Nem nướng Nha Trang comes from Ninh Hòa.
texture: The pork is ground, seasoned, put on bamboo skewers, and grilled over charcoal. The outside is slightly charred and the inside stays soft.
taste: A bite of the roll is sweet, fatty, sour, tart, and crisp.
howToEat: Lay down a sheet of bánh tráng phơi sương. Add herbs, pickles, fried ram, and half a skewer, then roll it.
The herbs are xà lách, diếp cá, hẹ, and others, plus sour starfruit, tart green banana, and pickles.
Dip the roll in the sauce. The sauce is cooked from lean pork, liver, ground shrimp, sticky rice, and fermented bean, and it is yellow-orange.
where: Nem nướng Đặng Văn Quyên at 16A Lãn Ông, Nem nướng Vũ Thành An at 15 Tô Hiến Thành, and Nem nướng Ngọc Tiên at 59 Lê Thành Phương.
seoTitle: Nem nướng Nha Trang — the Ninh Hòa roll
seoDescription: A Nha Trang nem nướng roll from Ninh Hòa: herbs, pickles, fried ram, and a yellow-orange sauce, at three shop addresses.
